resources.string: Orbit turns the dial on your CMF Buds Pro 2 case into a controller. Double-press the dial to open a wheel of tools, turn to pick, press to select; turning then scrolls, zooms, changes brightness or switches apps. This service draws the wheel on screen and performs those actions (scroll gestures, zoom, back/home/recents, screenshots, opening apps). It also sees presses of hardware buttons (volume keys, remotes, keyboards, game pads) so that the buttons you add as a controller can drive Orbit instead of their usual action; other buttons pass through untouched, and which keys you press is never recorded. It only acts when you use the dial or your controller. It does not read or store the content of your screen, with two exceptions: the name of the app in front, to offer recent apps in the Apps tool, and, only when you press the dial with the Camera or Teleprompter tool, the buttons of the app in front, to find and press its shutter or play / pause. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
